```yaml
name: Test

on:
  workflow_call:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'tests/**'
      - 'bun.lockb'
      - 'package.json'
      - '.github/workflows/test.yml'

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v1
        with:
          bun-version: latest

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install

      - name: Run tests
        run: bun run test
```
